findings.scenario: The rewrapped module docstring leaves line 15 at 116 characters. pyproject.toml sets line-length = 100 and selects E. CI's validate.yml step 'Lint (ruff check + format)' runs `make lint`, which runs `uv run ruff check scripts/ plugins/ tests/`. I ran `uv run --offline ruff check` on the file and it reports E501 'Found 1 error', so CI goes red on this change. The behaviour fixes themselves hold up. All 37 tests pass. I also ran the script on a scratch repo with node_modules/CLAUDE.md, node_modules/pkg/CLAUDE.md and an ignored nested repo vendor/lib/CLAUDE.md: it flagged only the top-level node_modules/CLAUDE.md, as the bug report intends.
findings.fix: Rewrap the docstring paragraph to 100 columns or fewer, e.g. put '.claude/CLAUDE.local.md is not a file Claude Code reads, so it is not flagged.' on one line and 'The user's ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md is not flagged.' on the next. Then rerun `make lint`.

findings.scenario: The change makes check 15 look at the top level of each wholly ignored folder. Reproduced: with `node_modules/` ignored, the script now reports `node_modules/CLAUDE.md replaces AGENTS.md for a session started in node_modules/`. The scripts docstring and references/checks.md were updated to say "except below the top level of a wholly ignored folder". The SKILL.md check table, the summary the skill reads to explain check 15, still says "except inside a wholly ignored folder such as node_modules". So the skill tells users that a file it now flags is exempt.
findings.fix: Change the SKILL.md row-15 wording to match checks.md: "except below the top level of a wholly ignored folder such as node_modules".
